changeSummary.20261028120000_pm_no_hod_assignment_fall: Project Managers may assign Staff directly when the task department has no active HOD; HOD-first routing is unchanged elsewhere. Entity write policies point at the current mutator instead of the renamed legacy function.
changeSummary.20261028130000_service_command_guard_dir: The service command entity-type guard checks only the command's own writes, not rows maintained by progress triggers, and workflow generation may record its task ids on its deliverable.
changeSummary.20261028140000_task_stage_guard_correcti: The responsible PM can complete a Waiting Approval task whose approval mode is none; Staff can create tasks that start in Pending; HODs are no longer limited to the ordinary Staff status action list.
changeSummary.20261028150000_hod_patch_empty_defaults: HOD saves are no longer rejected when the app fills absent fields with defaults or omits the server-kept accountableLeadId/reviewCover; real changes to restricted fields stay denied.
changeSummary.20261028160000_optional_task_output: Output is optional when submitting any task, including deliverable-linked work; a supplied output link must still be a valid https URL without credentials.
changeSummary.20261029120000_pm_company_handover: A Project Manager who owns a company may hand it to another non-admin Project Manager; Boss Koo can still assign any owner. Both the company guard trigger and the service command accept the handover.
changeSummary.20261102120000_plan_activation_entity_ty: A client_plan.manage command may insert the first service cycle and its deliverables (plan activation); it still cannot update or delete them. Since 20261023180000 every activation was rejected as invalid data.
changeSummary.20261102130000_hod_assignee_output_files: An HOD who is the assignee may change outputAttachments on that task (uploading their own output); other restricted fields and Staff-routed work stay protected, and the output file guard still validates files.
changeSummary.20261102140000_addon_save_entity_types: An addon.manage command may insert its pricing snapshot and update draft cycles (the add-on listing); published cycles stay protected. Since 20261023180000 every new add-on was rejected as invalid data.
changeSummary.20261102150000_task_assigned_at_format: HOD saves compare assignedAt as an instant (to the millisecond). Older tasks stored the Postgres text form while the app re-sends the JavaScript ISO form, so every HOD save on those tasks was rejected as a restricted-field change.
changeSummary.20261102160000_company_rename_with_proje: A company rename sends the company, its projects and its tasks in one command; the executor checks all operations before writing, so the project and task name checks saw the old company name and every rename of a company with projects was rejected. The command wrappers record this command's renames for the transaction and the two name checks accept either name for exactly those companies.
changeSummary.20261103090000_hod_legacy_task_reassign: The department HOD on a task's project may reassign older tasks that record no responsible HOD; before this, every such handoff was refused although the app offered it. Work outside the HOD's departments or projects stays refused.
